g.text: TRIGGER HAS NO INTRINSIC SIZE OR SURFACE.
POSITIONER MAY FLIP OR SHIFT AT VIEWPORT EDGES.
LABELS WRAP; ROW HEIGHT CAN GROW.
H1 IS THE SINGLE-LINE BASELINE ONLY.
ROW R2 IS 3; CONCENTRIC REFERENCE R3 IS 2.
BORDER MUST BE COUNTED IN THE INSET.
NO SCRIM. PANEL CLIPS; INNER VIEWPORT SCROLLS.
NOMINAL EXTENTS USE THE MAXIMUM OF TWO SHADOWS.
BLUR HAS NO HARD EDGE; THIS IS A DRAWING CONVENTION.
SCALE 1:1 · W IS CALLER / CONTENT DEPENDENT
W=224 DRAWN FOR LEGIBILITY; NOT A WIDTH CONTRACT.
SUBMENU HAS THE SAME PANEL / ROW GEOMETRY.
POINTER OPEN: NO INITIAL ROW HIGHLIGHT.
PROPORTIONAL TARGET · NO FIXED WT OR HT
D1 WAIT → Q WHILE HELD → D2 MENU OPEN.
MOVEMENT > D3 ON EITHER AXIS CANCELS.
PROPORTIONAL SCHEMATIC · LAYER SEPARATION NOT TO SCALE
LAYER ORDER IS STRUCTURAL; NO SCRIM IS INSERTED.
SCALE 2:1 · SINGLE LINE BASELINE · TRAILING SLOT IS OPTIONAL
LEAD GLYPH ↔ LOADER: SAME I1 BOX. TRAIL: CHECK / RADIO / CHEVRON.
H1 = 2·S3 + MAX(L1,I1) = 28; WRAPPING ADDS LINE HEIGHT.
SHORTCUT HUGS ITS CONTENT AND START-ALIGNS; NO TEXT WIDTH IS SPECIFIED.
